summary: EARTH Thunder "scavengers." Members activate straight from your hand to destroy a card, then swarm the board and loot the wreckage for more resources. Aggressive and hand-trap-resistant, and confirmed as a real competitive deck: a Blitzclique build made Top 16 at the 511-player WCQ China Mainland Qualifying Regional in Guangzhou (May 17, 2026).

cards.name: Whisker Blitzclique
cards.effectText: CORI-EN010. Released under the early/leaked name "Wisca Blitzclique" — official English print name is Whisker Blitzclique. Each effect once per turn. (1) If a card was destroyed by a "Blitzclique" card's effect this turn (Quick Effect): reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon up to 3 Thunder monsters from your hand, then you can destroy up to that many cards on the field — but you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters for the rest of the turn except from the hand. (2) When a monster effect is activated, except in the hand (Quick Effect): return 1 other Thunder monster you control to the hand; negate that activation and destroy the activating monster.

cards.name: Surge Blitzclique
cards.effectText: CORI-EN011. Reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 monster on the field: destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand (locking you into Effect Monsters from the hand only for the rest of the turn). On the field, when a card is destroyed by a card effect: add a "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Crackle Blitzclique
cards.effectText: CORI-EN012. Released under the early/leaked name "Crack Blitzclique" — official English print name is Crackle Blitzclique. (Quick Effect) When your opponent activates a monster effect on their turn: reveal this card in your hand; destroy that monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand (locking you into Effect Monsters from the hand only for the rest of the turn). If another card is destroyed by a card effect while this card is in the Monster Zone (except Damage Step): send 1 "Blitzclique" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Grain Blitzclique
cards.effectText: CORI-EN013. Reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field: destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand (locking you into Effect Monsters from the hand only for the rest of the turn). If another card is destroyed by a card effect while this monster is on the field: add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Surge Blitzclique." Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Emi Blitzclique
cards.effectText: CORI-EN014. If this card is added to your hand except by drawing it: reveal this card, then target 1 card on the field: destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand (locking you into Effect Monsters from the hand only for the rest of the turn). If another card is destroyed by a card effect while this card is in the Monster Zone (except Damage Step): add 1 "Blitzclique" Trap from your Deck to your hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Breakaway
cards.effectText: Activate 1 of these effects: place 1 "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone; OR return 1 Thunder monster you control to the hand, then target 1 card on the field and destroy it. If a card is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect while this card is in the GY: add this card to your hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Stepped Leader
cards.effectText: If a card is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect: target 1 Thunder monster in your GY and add it to your hand. During your Main Phase: Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, then destroy this card. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Return Stroke
cards.effectText: Your "Blitzclique" monsters cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. When your opponent activates a Spell or a monster effect: return 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control to the hand; negate that activation and destroy the activating card. Banish this card from your GY: target 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control or in your GY and return it to the hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Alternator
cards.effectText: Your opponent's monsters lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. Shuffle 1 other "Blitzclique" card you control or in your hand into the Deck: add 1 differently-named Thunder monster from your Deck to your hand. Banish this card from your GY: add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or "Kowloon, Citadel of the Sky" from your Deck to your hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Kowloon, Citadel of the Sky
cards.effectText: During your Main Phase: Special Summon 1 "Mechbeast Token" (Machine/EARTH/Level 6/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your opponent's field, and if you do, add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand. Monsters you control that were Normal or Special Summoned from the hand gain 500 ATK/DEF. If a card is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect while this card is in your GY: add this card to your hand.

comboLines.title: Reading the "no more Effect Monsters" clause
comboLines.body: Every Blitzclique monster's hand-reveal effect carries the same drawback: once you use it, you cannot Special Summon any further Effect Monsters this turn except from the hand. That makes the deck's real engine a chain of hand reveals feeding each other's "add a Blitzclique monster/Trap to hand" triggers (Surge, Grain, and Emi's on-field effects) rather than one explosive extend — you're refilling your hand faster than you're spending it. Breakaway can pre-place Return Stroke or Alternator face-up before you commit to a reveal, and Kowloon adds a free hand card plus 500 ATK/DEF to whatever you swarm with. Treat each reveal as "destroy something, get one more body," not as a single card that solves the board — this is a grindy, resilient aggro shell, not a one-card full-combo engine.

sampleDecklist.label: Blitzclique is a real, competitively-placing archetype (Top 16, WCQ China Mainland Qualifying Regional, Guangzhou, May 17 2026, 511 players) but the exact Top-cut list wasn't retrievable from this environment. This 40 uses the confirmed card pool (all 5 Blitzclique monsters, all 4 Blitzclique Spells/Traps, and Kowloon) filled out with standard generic staples — a reasonable competitive shell, not the verified Top 16 list.
